claims.statement: Token count is ten per user/application/scope combination and hourly issuance limit is separately ten. Exceeding count revokes within the same combination. With grace feature enabled, choose oldest never-used token older than one minute, otherwise least-recently-used if any used, otherwise oldest even within one minute. Without feature, oldest never-used precedes least-recently-used when all used. Recent protection is qualified, not absolute.

Hourly rate-limit exhaustion does not revoke the oldest token; it prompts browser reauthorization to review permissions and interrupt potential token-request loops. Prompt appearance is not actual approval or effective token issuance.
